traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Difference for its own sake: eccentricity, instability, shocking others to no purpose. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for selfhood against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the selfhood/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: An abrupt resignation can void dates and promises that were already given to clients, staff, or partners. Sun square Uranus can turn one person's break from the arrangement into immediate instability for everyone who built plans around their authority. The argument about who owns the project can wait long enough to protect the people depending on it. Confirm who can make decisions now, which commitments still stand, and what needs to be postponed. The first job is not restoring appearances. It is keeping the sudden break from creating avoidable damage downstream.
